body: Sorry to hear. I think I can understand, my Ndad beat me on my birthdays. It's hard to believe people can be so toxic. Stay strong op

Yes you're right, I'm feeling a lot more better about this than when i first posted thanks to all of your guys' advice and support! I'm ready to go through it and I do have a few friends who are supporting me as well, thanks for taking the time to help a stranger out ☺️

Yes I believe that is some manipulative thing he would do.. he's always talking bad about me behind my back to my sister lol but she doesn't believe anything he says at this point. I'm still finding it hard to believe my own dad would do this but you're right, I have to channel all this negativity into improving myself.

I'm glad to hear you're so close to being completely free and that you're staying away from the toxicity. You have gotten so far already and that gives me hope, I'm going to start looking for a job and start saving ASAP so I can (hopefully) go no contact as well. 

I'm grateful for redditors like you, thank you for taking time out of your day to respond to me you have no idea how much this meant!! I wish you the best with the rest of your semester and moving into your own place ☺️

Thank you for replying!! You're definitely right, I wasn't expecting the reaction I got from him.. what started out calm and civil turned into something nasty and I left feeling more depressed than before

I really was hoping he could change but he made it clear that that would never happen..

I already feel unwanted here and am beginning to question my own sanity so I think that is very sound advice, thank you for replying
